about: Which MuseTester tests cover each part of the apps (js/<name>.js). tests/musetester-lint.cjs (CI) fails when a file in js/ isn't here, or names a test that doesn't exist: a new feature comes with its test. "todo" marks a part with no test yet (printed as a gap); "none" one that can't have its own (say why).

appsteps.todo: record and replay of app steps (app.step) in a script

chat.todo: a conversation with the language model, its memory learning

dataviz.todo: the data widget: CSV, a chart, read-only SQLite

duplex.todo: conversation mode (needs a microphone: a human step)

mocap.none: motion capture needs a camera and a person in front of it

ostasks.todo: an AppleScript/shell task (each code is approved in a native dialog: a human step)

people.none: hands, pose and face tracking need a camera and a person

presenter.todo: the presenter view window during a script

radio.todo: the radio widget playing a station

scriptedit.todo: the script editor: storyboard cards, the step wizard

taskbuild.todo: building a task by talking (needs a model)

taskedit.todo: the task editor and Teach me

vision.none: the camera widget needs a camera

webdrive.todo: web steps recorded and replayed in a web widget
